title: Escrow Agreement

issues.quote: The Escrow Agent shall invest the Escrow Funds only in United States Treasury bills that mature no more than 90 days after purchase.
issues.why: The Escrow Agent is not a party (it only acknowledges receipt); "shall" cannot bind it. Every other Escrow Agent provision correctly uses "must".

issues.quote: Buyer may not recover more than $40,000 from the Escrow Funds for Losses that result from environmental conditions at the clinic.
issues.why: Unclear whether the $40,000 limit applies to each claim or to all environmental claims in the aggregate.
issues.fix: Buyer may not recover more than $40,000 in the aggregate from the Escrow Funds for Losses that result from environmental conditions at the clinic.

issues.quote: "Objection Period" means the 15 days after Seller receives a Claim Notice.
issues.why: The Objection Period is 15 days, but Seller may deliver an Objection Notice up to 20 days after receiving the Claim Notice; the Escrow Agent could pay Buyer before Seller's deadline ends.
issues.fix: Use 1 period: define the Objection Period as 20 days and have Seller object "before the Objection Period ends".

issues.quote: The Escrow Agent must pay Buyer the amount of each Claim Notice no later than 5 days after the day on which the Objection Period ends, unless Seller shall have delivered an Objection Notice before that day.
issues.fix: unless Seller has delivered an Objection Notice before that day

issues.quote: Seller shall reimburse Buyer for any additional fee that the Escrow Agent charges because of its failure to give a notice that this agreement requires.
issues.why: "its" could refer to Seller, Buyer, or the Escrow Agent.
issues.fix: because of Seller's failure to give a notice that this agreement requires

traps.quote: The Escrow Agent must hold the Escrow Funds in a segregated account at First Horizon Bank and must not commingle the Escrow Funds with any other funds.
traps.why_correct: The Escrow Agent is a nonparty; "must" is correct (MSCD 3.150).

traps.quote: The Escrow Agent must hold the Escrow Funds in a segregated account at First Horizon Bank and must not commingle the Escrow Funds with any other funds.
traps.why_correct: A number word inside a proper name stays (house rule 2).

traps.anchor: the day on which the Objection Period ends
traps.quote: The Escrow Agent must pay Buyer the amount of each Claim Notice no later than 5 days after the day on which the Objection Period ends, unless Seller shall have delivered an Objection Notice before that day.

traps.anchor: Escrow Agent is not required to determine
traps.quote: The Escrow Agent is not required to determine whether any Claim Notice or Objection Notice is valid.
traps.why_correct: House exception to active voice: "is not required to" (MSCD 3.292).

traps.quote: Neither Buyer nor Seller may instruct the Escrow Agent to release any Escrow Funds except by a joint written instruction or as this agreement provides.
traps.why_correct: Negative subject with "may" is correct (house rule 8).

notes: Blake's draft.  The escrow agent is not a party: it signs only an acknowledgment of receipt, and the background says so.  "the Escrow Agent" with "the" is a role label, which keeps the article.  The draft uses no statements of fact, so "states" does not arise.  Clean otherwise: 2-space sentences, house enumeration, digits, U.S. dates.
